purpose: Prevent unlabeled structural components from silently becoming background in a wall-capable column/beam/wall detector.
current_blockers: Wall QA is in progress: 14/14 pilot pages have page-level review, but instance bbox QA is not complete.
Only two pilot pages have human-confirmed structural-wall semantics, and their wall instance boxes are still pending.
The current 16-record review stream contains 4 column and 12 beam candidates but 0 wall records; this stream must not be used to train a three-class detector.
Final human approval of the 16 beam/column candidates remains pending.
required_before_wall_capable_training: Create and review tight source-page wall instance candidates on the human-confirmed wall-positive pages.
Re-review training pages so unlabeled column, beam or wall instances are not silently treated as background.
Keep ambiguous instances out of negative labels and route them to QA.
Complete human QA for new wall candidates and final human approval for promotable beam/column candidates.
Run validation, cross-split duplicate, provenance and source-page regressions before dataset release.
note: This gate is a dataset/training-safety artifact. It does not activate ontology v0.2, does not approve wall handoff, and does not create Core entities or engineering geometry.
